name: Infrastructure & Cloud Cost Governance
description: Infrastructure & Cloud Cost Governance standard. Defines enforceable rules, implementation boundaries, failure handling and review evidence expected when STD-COST applies.

rules.title: Tag or attribute cloud resources to accountable owners and environments
rules.detail: Resources and major shared services expose enough metadata for cost allocation and anomaly investigation.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Tag or attribute cloud resources to accountable owners and environments.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Tag or attribute cloud resources to accountable owners and environments.

rules.title: Define budgets and anomaly alerts
rules.detail: Projects establish expected spend and notify owners when daily/monthly cost deviates materially from baseline or budget.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Define budgets and anomaly alerts.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Define budgets and anomaly alerts.

rules.title: Measure unit cost for material workloads
rules.detail: Where meaningful, track cost per request/user/job/storage unit or business transaction to distinguish growth from inefficiency.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Measure unit cost for material workloads.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Measure unit cost for material workloads.

rules.title: Right-size using measured utilization
rules.detail: Scale instance sizes, retention, storage tiers and autoscaling from telemetry rather than permanent peak provisioning.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Right-size using measured utilization.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Right-size using measured utilization.

rules.title: Include cost impact in architecture and performance decisions
rules.detail: New managed services, high-cardinality telemetry, egress and duplication of data require explicit cost consideration.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Include cost impact in architecture and performance decisions.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Include cost impact in architecture and performance decisions.

rules.title: Do not trade away required reliability or security solely for cost
rules.detail: Optimization must preserve approved SLO, backup, compliance and security requirements.
rules.example_good: The implementation and review evidence demonstrate: Do not trade away required reliability or security solely for cost.
rules.example_bad: The change violates or ignores the rule: Do not trade away required reliability or security solely for cost.

integration_guide.title: Resolve applicability and dependencies
integration_guide.description: Confirm where STD-COST applies and resolve its extends/implements/uses/aligns_with dependencies in the project standard profile.

integration_guide.title: Record project decisions
integration_guide.description: Apply the rules of Infrastructure & Cloud Cost Governance to requirements/design/ADRs and record any project-specific thresholds, providers or justified exceptions.

integration_guide.title: Implement with evidence
integration_guide.description: Implement the applicable MUST/SHOULD rules and link code, configuration, tests or review evidence to the change.

integration_guide.title: Verify before completion
integration_guide.description: Run automated checks where possible and manual review for judgement-based rules; close or approve documented deviations.

common_issues.issue: Infrastructure & Cloud Cost Governance is applied inconsistently across features
common_issues.cause: The project references the standard but does not resolve concrete ownership, thresholds or verification evidence.
common_issues.solution: Resolve dependencies, record project-specific decisions and include applicable rules in implementation/review checks.

common_issues.issue: Implementation satisfies the happy path but misses Infrastructure & Cloud Cost Governance failure cases
common_issues.cause: Boundary, retry, security or recovery scenarios were not included in acceptance/test planning.
common_issues.solution: Use the standard rules to add explicit failure/recovery scenarios and verify them before release.
